President Donald Trump won a second term in 2024 on four central pledges: seal the border, avoid new foreign wars, fix the economy and clean up Washington. Nineteen months into his term, polling shows him underwater on the four of them. [...] The economy was Trump's second-strongest issue when he took office. Today it ranks among his weakest. results.content: An average of national polls has 38.6 percent of Americans giving Trump a thumbs up today, a 0.4-point increase from where he stood on August 3. In comparison, 57.7 percent give him a thumbs down, a drop of 1.1 points from last month’s number. Trump’s net approval rating now stands at -19.1 points. His lowest number so far this year was the -20.6 points he recorded last month. [...] In short, after ruling in August that it was premature to decide the constitutionality of Trump’s actions, the Court could hold in September or October that it is too late to decide. A legal Catch-22.
